name: Gonti, Lord of Luxury
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When Gonti enters, look at the top four cards of target opponent's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of that library in a random order. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
blocked_sentences: You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

needs.what: a flag on look_at_top's (and exile's) playable permission that grants permission to CAST the exiled card only, never to PLAY it as a land, so a land Gonti exiles from an opponent's library stays exiled
needs.why_existing_wont_do: look_at_top with playable while_exiled, any_type and face_down says everything else exactly, but the permission is a PLAY permission: legality.py offers an exiled land with playable_by == pid as a land play, which the printed 'cast' forbids
